note: Decomposition of the UNFITTED (Zhat == 0) model's objective against the TRAIN bank, so it is comparable to the 'objective' column of losses/seed_*_losses.csv. That column is complete_objective_value = LAMBDA_SCALE * discrepancy + running_cost, NOT a pure goodness-of-fit number. With allow_drift_correction false the drift part of the running cost is a constant that Algorithm 1 cannot reduce.
